item.title: Off the Menu 2.3.0
item.description: 2.3.0 — THE PRESTIGE UPDATE. Every run is different now: clear a wave and the savanna PROVIDES — pick 1 of 3 boons (Thick Hide, Golden Gut, Second Wind, and rarer things after bosses) that stack for the whole run. Every fifth wave is a BOSS — Prince Reginald the Unbitten, Duchess Wideload, General Nibbles and worse — each with a name, a health bar, a grudge, and a backstory that plays before the fight. New RECORDS wall and a DAILY HUNT whose recipe changes every day. And the big one: PRESTIGE. Max out a hero's three tracks (5/5/5) and prestige them into a visibly beefier, stronger self. Prestige all six, defeat the tier's gate boss, and the whole game resets at Prestige Tier 2 — where THIRD-PERSON view unlocks. Story artwork now ships at full resolution. Tiers 3-5 (two feet + running, the weapon shop + first person, weapon upgrades) are on the herd screen, locked, waiting their turn.
